name: Pentostatin (2'-deoxycoformycin) +/- Rituximab
histology: classic hairy cell leukemia (cHCL); CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+, CD123+, CD5-, CD23-; usually BRAF V600E mutated

biomarkers.note: Classic HCL characteristically harbors BRAF V600E; variant HCL lacks it. BRAF status does not gate purine-analog therapy but distinguishes cHCL from vHCL and enables later BRAF-inhibitor salvage. Per DeVita 12th ed. (lines 281710 to 281725) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hairy Cell Leukemia, v1.2027 (extract line 190).

lineOfTherapy: first-line for classic HCL requiring treatment; a preferred initial purine-analog option with comparable activity to cladribine. Also used at relapse (re-treat with prior agent if remission was durable).

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: indication for treatment present (progressive cytopenias, symptomatic splenomegaly, or systemic symptoms)
in patients with active infection who cannot be controlled, consider low-dose pentostatin before standard-dose purine analog

drugs.name: Pentostatin
drugs.infusionDuration: IV; repeated every 2 weeks until maximum response

provenance.locator: line 281734 (pentostatin administered at 4 mg/m2 every 2 weeks until maximum response)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 281734. Pentostatin 4 mg/m2 IV every 2 weeks until maximum response (day 1 of a 14-day cycle, repeated). Pentostatin causes immunosuppression and prolonged lymphopenia; give PJP and herpes/VZV prophylaxis and monitor for opportunistic infection. In patients with active infection, low-dose pentostatin may be used to secure a durable response before standard-dose purine analogs (NCCN footnote, extract lines 341, 763). Bone marrow response can be evaluated after blood counts recover (NCCN footnote, extract line 434).

drugs.name: Rituximab

provenance.locator: Rituximab with pentostatin as combination therapy (extract line 413, Else et al.); dose value 375 mg/m2 weekly per Harrison 22nd ed. line 385777

drugs.notes: OPTIONAL add-on (Pentostatin +/- Rituximab). Rituximab combined with pentostatin is an effective purine-analog + CD20 mAb approach, particularly at relapse (NCCN extract lines 410, 413). Rituximab dose VALUE 375 mg/m2 weekly is sourced to Harrison 22nd ed. line 385777; the exact per-cycle scheduling with pentostatin follows standard practice. Screen hepatitis B before rituximab (reactivation risk).

premedications.name: Hydration
premedications.notes: adequate hydration with pentostatin; adjust dose for renal impairment per labeling

supportiveCare: PJP (Pneumocystis jirovecii) and herpes/VZV prophylaxis - pentostatin immunosuppression and prolonged lymphopenia.
Screen hepatitis B before rituximab if rituximab is added (NCCN HCL workup, extract line 211).
Renal function monitoring - pentostatin is renally cleared.

monitoring: Bone marrow after count recovery to assess response (pentostatin)

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce or hold pentostatin for renal impairment per labeling; pentostatin is renally cleared. Clinical review required.
Consider low-dose pentostatin before standard-dose purine analog to secure response (NCCN HCL footnote). Clinical review required.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 281734 (pentostatin 4 mg/m2 every 2 weeks until maximum response); lines 281731 to 281745 (nucleoside analogs mainstay of HCL therapy)

guideline.locator: Pentostatin as an initial regimen (extract line 289); cladribine and pentostatin have comparable therapeutic activity (footnote e, extract line 343); low-dose pentostatin before standard-dose purine analog in active infection (extract lines 341, 763); rituximab with pentostatin combination (extract lines 410, 413); response-assessment timing after count recovery (footnote, extract line 434)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for pentostatin +/- rituximab, a preferred first-line purine-analog option for classic hairy cell leukemia with activity comparable to cladribine. The pentostatin dose (4 mg/m2 IV every 2 weeks until maximum response) is concretely sourced to DeVita 12th ed. line 281734. The optional rituximab add-on is supported by Standard Guidelines (NCCN) HCL v1.2027 (extract lines 410, 413); the rituximab dose value 375 mg/m2 weekly is sourced to Harrison 22nd ed. line 385777. cycleLengthDays 14 reflects the every-2-weeks pentostatin schedule; cycles is VERIFY because dosing continues to maximum response rather than a fixed number. Pentostatin immunosuppression with PJP and VZV prophylaxis, renal dosing, and the low-dose-pentostatin-in-active-infection caveat are captured. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
